subject: Partial region failover — proposed remediation split and RCA schedule
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@brightcart.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: SRE Team <sre-team@brightcart.com>, Ops Manager <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 01:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [Redwood] Saturday failover — partial region impact

Diego,

We saw a repeat of the US-W private failover you mentioned during the weekend. Between 23:45 and 00:20 UTC our checkout path experienced a significant spike in 503s and a higher median latency (>350ms) for tokenization calls. That window lines up roughly with the regional failover notes in your status page but our finance team needs confirmation on exact start/end times and whether this meets the SLO definition for a tenant-impacting outage.

We also need a proposal for how compensation would be applied — our legal prefers a proportional split when multiple regions are involved. Can you confirm the impact window, provide raw traces (tokenization and auth) and a suggested remediation/credit calculation? We’re trying to settle an invoice dispute before renewal next month.

Thanks,
Alex
Ops Lead, BrightCart
From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 03:05:12 +0000
Subject: Re: [Redwood] Saturday failover — partial region impact

Alex — thanks for the detail and the heads up. I’m escalating this internally and will get you a precise timeline and the trace bundle by EOD. Preliminary notes: the incident stemmed from a constrained leader election after a burst of preemptions in a subset of US-W capacity — we observed transient kv-cache eviction cascades that increased tokenization latency.

Next steps on our side:
- I’ve looped in Laura from commercial to align on compensation mechanics.
- David (engineer) will pull a full trace + request/response pairs and an aggregated timeline.
- We’ll propose a proportional compensation model (per-tenant weighted by token volume in the impacted region) and send the math and evidence.

I’ll attach the initial log extract once David posts it.

—Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 06:17:45 +0000
Subject: Fwd: trace extracts and window candidate (internal)

Diego / Laura — attaching the raw short-window extracts. Key points from the traces:
- Candidate impact window: 2026-11-03T23:46:30Z -> 2026-11-03T00:19:57Z (region US-W primary cluster)
- Symptom: sudden KV cache thrashing after 2 preemptions reduced leader replicas; tokenization RPC latency median rose from ~18ms to ~220ms, 503 rate for checkout path rose to 6.4% for affected tenants.
- Mitigation: autoscale responded and leader election completed; traffic shifted to surviving replicas by 00:20Z.

Attachments: redwood-logs-usw2-2026-11-03-summary.txt, kvcache-eviction-trace-2026-11-03.json

I recommend we offer BrightCart a proportional credit computed as: (tenant's tokenized requests in impacted window / total tenant tokenized requests during billing period) * monthly service charge * outage_fraction. I’ll include the per-tenant token counts in the next update.

-David
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@brightcart.com>, diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Proposed remediation and compensation split for BrightCart

Alex — thanks for your patience. Based on David’s evidence I’ve put together a short proposal to close this quickly:

Proposal summary:
- Confirmed impact window: 2026-11-03T23:46:30Z -> 2026-11-03T00:19:57Z UTC.
- Eligibility: Per our SLA definitions this qualifies as a partial regional availability disruption because >5% of requests to the tenant’s checkout route returned 5xx and tokenization latency exceeded the SLO median threshold for >15 continuous minutes.
- Proposed remedy: 25% pro-rata credit on the monthly service fee attributable to request-processing charges for the impacted billing period. The 25% comes from combining the measured outage fraction and our internal apportionment model (we traced that ~42% of BrightCart traffic routed through the affected US-W shard during the window).
- Timeline: Credit applied to next invoice; we will issue a formal credit note and update the billing ledger within 7 business days after you approve.

Requested next steps from BrightCart:
1) Confirm you accept the 25% pro-rata credit approach (or propose an alternative apportionment).
2) If accepted, please confirm the invoice number to apply the credit against.
3) Let us know whether you’d like a joint RCA call (we suggest 30–45 minutes) — we’re available Fri 2026-11-06 16:00 UTC or Mon 2026-11-09 15:00 UTC.

If you want the full per-tenant token accounting I can attach that in a follow-up.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morgan <alex@brightcart.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: SRE Team <sre-team@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2026 16:29:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation and compensation split for BrightCart

Laura — appreciate the clear timeline and math. We accept the 25% pro-rata credit applied to invoice INV-2026-10-9987. Please attach the per-tenant token accounting bundle for our records. We’d like the RCA call Friday 2026-11-06 16:00 UTC — Alex + two SREs will join.

Also please include the raw traces in a redacted form (remove internal IPs) — legal will want them archived.

Thanks,
Alex
From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@brightcart.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:42:10 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation and compensation split for BrightCart — next steps

Alex / team — confirmed: we will apply the 25% pro-rata credit to INV-2026-10-9987 and issue a credit note within 3 business days. David has prepared the redacted trace bundle and the per-tenant token accounting PDF; both are attached to this thread. We’re set for the RCA on 2026-11-06 16:00 UTC (meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/meetings/rdw-rca-20261105).

Post-RCA actions we will own:
- Permanent mitigation to reduce eviction cascade risk during leader election windows (engineering P0).
- Documentation update to our public SLO guidance clarifying multi-region apportionment.
- Delivery of the formal credit note and billing ledger update.

If anything changes before the call, I’ll post an update here. Appreciate the quick resolution.

—Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
